extraction_notes: The datasheet identifies the device as an N-channel 60 V MOSFET and lists UTD Semiconductor Co., Limited with UMW branding; the requested manufacturer identity is preserved as UMW Youtai Semiconductor Co Ltd.

Transfer, on-region, body-diode, and capacitance curves are usable and were digitized as approximate points from Figures 1, 2, 6, and 8. Figure 1 and Figure 6 do not state a curve temperature in the figure itself.
Zero-gate-voltage drain current IDSS is 1 uA maximum at VDS = 60 V, VGS = 0 V, TJ = 25 degC, p. 3.
Gate-body leakage IGSS is +/-100 nA maximum at VGS = +/-20 V, VDS = 0 V, TJ = 25 degC, p. 3.
Total gate charge Qg is 25 nC typical at VDS = 30 V, IDS = 15 A, VGS = 10 V; Qgs is 4.5 nC typical and Qgd is 6.5 nC typical under the same conditions, p. 3.
Reverse recovery time trr is 29 ns typical at TJ = 25 degC and IF = 15 A; reverse recovery charge Qrr is 45 uC typical at di/dt = 100 A/us, p. 4.

Junction-to-case thermal resistance RthetaJC is 2.7 degC/W maximum, p. 2. The absolute maximum ratings include VDS = 60 V, VGS = +/-20 V, continuous ID = 30 A at TC = 25 degC and 20 A at TC = 100 degC, pulsed IDM = 120 A, and PD = 55 W at TC = 25 degC, p. 1.
